claims: In 2026, the U.S. stock market (NYSE and NASDAQ) will be closed on 10 holidays.
NYSE and NASDAQ will be closed on New Year's Day, Thursday, January 1, 2026.
NYSE and NASDAQ will be closed on Martin Luther King, Jr. Day, Monday, January 19, 2026.
NYSE and NASDAQ will be closed on Presidents' Day, Monday, February 16, 2026.
NYSE and NASDAQ will be closed on Good Friday, Friday, April 3, 2026.
NYSE and NASDAQ will be closed on Memorial Day, Monday, May 25, 2026.
NYSE and NASDAQ will be closed on Juneteenth, Friday, June 19, 2026.
NYSE and NASDAQ will be closed on Independence Day (Observed), Friday, July 3, 2026.
NYSE and NASDAQ will be closed on Labor Day, Monday, September 7, 2026.
NYSE and NASDAQ will be closed on Thanksgiving Day, Thursday, November 26, 2026.
NYSE and NASDAQ will be closed on Christmas Day, Friday, December 25, 2026.
NYSE and NASDAQ will close early at 1:00 p.m. ET on Friday, July 3, 2026.
NYSE and NASDAQ will close early at 1:00 p.m. ET on Friday, November 27, 2026.
U.S. stock market holidays that fall on a Saturday are usually observed on the preceding Friday.
U.S. stock market holidays that fall on a Sunday are usually observed on the following Monday.
